outcome: Odds of having time to expulsion ≥24 hours
cohort: Participants were 382 individuals with singleton pregnancies undergoing medication abortion over 13 weeks gestational duration at a single academic medical center between 2020 and 2024.
finding: Individuals with a BMI >30 had significantly longer second and third-trimester time to fetal expulsion compared to those with a BMI <25.
followup_time: Observation of fetal expulsion process (median 12-20 hours, up to ≥24 hours)
